text:
Priya Singh: Heads up — we're seeing a spike in 429s starting ~1829001100. Multiple orgs (org-8723, org-19, org-44) hit per-key throttles after a console rollout. Gateway -> quota-service logs show burst applied as 0 for routes that should be untouched.
Jason Wu: On it. Which console change was rolled?
Priya Singh: I pushed the UI change to allow 'apply to matching routes' for quota overrides at 23:54 UTC. I think a bad default was shipped.
Maya Patel: Can you paste the override payload that got applied?
Priya Singh: Sure — from the audit stream:```json
{"override_id":"ovr-992","match":"","match_type":"route-tag","burst":0,"per_key":true,"applied_by":"priya"}
```
Marco Rivera: burst=0 is suspicious — should be >=1. How did empty match get applied to many routes?
Priya Singh: The console trimmed the tag input and when empty it serialized as empty string rather than omitting the field. Backend treated empty match as wildcard. Looks like a translation bug.
infra-bot: quota-service: eval_override(ovr-992) -> matched_routes=
["/v1/billing/charge","/v1/billing/invoices","/v1/usage/events"]
quota-service: set burst=0 for 3 routes, per_key=true
Jason Wu: I'm running a quick aggregation to see impact. Query:```sql
SELECT org_id, count(*) as hits_429 FROM requests
WHERE status=429 AND ts > to_timestamp(1829001000)
GROUP BY org_id ORDER BY hits_429 DESC LIMIT 10;
```
Maya Patel: We should rollback the console change ASAP and patch quota-service to ignore burst<=0 until console validation is in.
Priya Singh: Kicking rollback now (reverting UI PR and reapplying previous override set).
deploy-bot: rollback: console-frontend rev 4722 -> 4719 triggered by priya at 1829001130. Canaries started (10% of users).
Marco Rivera: I'll push an emergency hotfix to quota-service to treat burst<1 as 1 and to ignore wildcard matches from empty strings.
Priya Singh: Applying emergency per-org patch for the top 5 affected orgs to set burst=2 until we confirm rollback.
infra-bot: emergency-patch: applied patches for org-8723, org-19, org-44, org-201 -> burst set to 2 (per_key=true)
Jason Wu: 429 rate dropped ~70% within 2 minutes after rollback + emergency patch. Continuing to monitor.
Maya Patel: Filing an incident ticket and a small postmortem checklist. We need console validation + backend guardrails + e2e test for empty tag serialization.
Marco Rivera: I'll open the PR: backend: ignore-empty-match-and-reject-on-zero-burst. Also add a lint rule on console to prevent submitting burst < 1.
Priya Singh: Root cause summary: console serialized empty tag as wildcard due to trimming bug and allowed burst=0 to be saved; quota-service interpreted that as a global override setting burst=0 on multiple routes which immediately limited bursts and caused per-key throttles (429s). Remediation: rollback, emergency per-org patch, backend guard and console validation.
Jason Wu: Assigning follow-ups: Priya (incident writeup + contact customers), Marco (backend fix + tests), Maya (console validation + e2e).
Priya Singh: Traffic returned to baseline at 1829001210. I'll draft the postmortem now. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
